_comment: Controlled standards & legislation library — the SINGLE source of truth for the RAMS authoring prompt (RamsAuthorService) and the deterministic validator (RamsProjectValidator). Version/transition logic is modelled explicitly; obsolete references and merely-conditional guidance are separate concepts. quick-260830-ramsqa.

standards.reference: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974
standards.title: General statutory duty of care

standards.reference: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999
standards.title: Risk assessment duty
Statutory duties for work at height
standards.notes: There is no ACOP for work at height — reference the Regulations directly (HSE guidance INDG401). Never invent an L-number ACOP for work at height.

standards.title: Manual handling
standards.applies_when: any display, mount or rack lift
standards.notes: No fixed 'safe' lifting weight exists in UK law.

standards.reference: Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 1998 (PUWER)
aliases: Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 1998
standards.title: Work equipment, access towers, tools
standards.applies_when: access equipment or power tools used

standards.reference: Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998 (LOLER)
aliases: Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998
standards.title: Lifting equipment
standards.applies_when: only where a lifting appliance or accessory is used

standards.title: Requirements for Electrical Installations (IET Wiring Regulations, 18th Edition)
standards.applies_when: only where 21CAV works on the fixed electrical installation (installation or alteration in scope) — NOT for connecting AV equipment to existing socket outlets
standards.notes: Amendment 4:2026 was published April 2026 and is current; the previous Amendment 3:2024 edition remains valid during the transition until 15 October 2026. Do not cite an earlier amendment (A2:2022 / A1:2020) as current. Connection to an existing socket outlet is NOT fixed-installation work.

standards.title: Audio/video, information and communication technology equipment — safety requirements
Telecommunications equipment and cabling — specification for installation, operation and maintenance
standards.notes: The amendment is A1:2017, not A1:2020.

standards.title: Information technology — cabling installation planning and practices inside buildings
standards.applies_when: cable routing, containment and separation from mains services

standards.title: Code of practice for the selection and installation of post-installed anchors in concrete and masonry
standards.applies_when: display/mount fixings using post-installed anchors in concrete or masonry
standards.notes: Base the fixing on the manufacturer's published design/load data in accordance with this code — never an assumed universal safety factor or invented proof-test value.

standards.reference: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations 2002 (COSHH)
aliases: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations 2002
standards.title: Hazardous substances, including respirable crystalline silica
standards.applies_when: any drilling into masonry/concrete, or hazardous substances carried

standards.reference: Control of Noise at Work Regulations 2005
aliases: Control of Noise at Work Regs 2005
standards.title: Noise at work
standards.notes: Noise uses EAV/ELV terminology (not the RCS WEL).

standards.reference: Control of Vibration at Work Regulations 2005
aliases: Control of Vibration at Work Regs 2005
standards.title: Hand-arm vibration
Construction project duties
standards.notes: See the cdm block for duty-holder and F10 rules.

standards.title: Asbestos
standards.applies_when: any penetrative work or void access in a building of pre-2000 or unknown age
standards.notes: Include whenever penetrative work / void access applies.

obsolete_or_superseded.reason: the CDM 2007 ACOP — withdrawn under CDM 2015; there is no work-at-height ACOP
not a current RIDDOR contact — do not invent an 'HSE Incident Hotline'

conditional_guidance.applies_when: excavation or work around underground services
conditional_guidance.note: Current HSE guidance — valid, but only cite where excavation / underground-service risk actually exists.

conditional_guidance.reference: L146 (Consulting workers on health and safety)
conditional_guidance.applies_when: the RAMS genuinely addresses worker-consultation arrangements
conditional_guidance.note: Current guidance — valid, not confined-spaces. Usually irrelevant to a project RAMS; omit rather than treating it as invalid.

conditional_guidance.applies_when: genuine confined-space work — ceiling voids and comms rooms are NOT confined spaces
conditional_guidance.note: Valid confined-spaces ACOP; do not cite for 21CAV void/comms work.
Valid PA standard; omit unless PA is in scope.

conditional_guidance.applies_when: glazing / human-impact-safety of glass in scope
conditional_guidance.note: A GLAZING standard — valid for glazing, but it is not an access, scaffold or work-at-height standard and must not be cited for those.

conditional_guidance.reference: ANSI/AVIXA F502.01:2018 (Rack Building for Audiovisual Systems)
conditional_guidance.applies_when: AV equipment racks are built / populated / assembled in scope
conditional_guidance.note: Real, current AVIXA workmanship standard for rack building — cite ONLY when equipment racks are actually built or populated. It is a build-quality standard, not a health-and-safety instrument, and does not belong in a display-only / socket-only RAMS.

reporting.riddor_note: Fatal accidents and specified injuries can be reported by telephone on 0345 300 9923; other RIDDOR reports are made online at hse.gov.uk.

exposure_limits.rcs_note: Respirable crystalline silica is a carcinogen: reduce exposure as low as reasonably practicable and control below the Workplace Exposure Limit. Never call this an 'EAV' — EAV/ELV belong to the noise and vibration regulations.

cdm.notifiable_rule: more than 30 working days AND more than 20 workers working simultaneously at any point, OR more than 500 person-days
cdm.f10_duty: the Client has the legal duty to ensure HSE is notified using Form F10 before the construction phase begins; the notification may be submitted on the Client's behalf, but the duty remains the Client's (never 'the Principal Contractor must notify HSE')
cdm.pd_pc_trigger: the project involves, or is likely to involve, more than one contractor (not whether contractors are on site 'simultaneously')
cdm.construction_phase_plan: where 21CAV is the sole contractor, 21CAV prepares the construction phase plan and the Client does NOT; where multiple contractors, the Client appoints a Principal Designer and Principal Contractor and ensures a plan is prepared
